name: three-actresses-luxury-editorial
image_purpose: luxury campaign and group lookbook image

prompt.project_info: Create a 9:16 studio luxury editorial portrait of three adult fashion models against a warm gray textured backdrop.
prompt.main_subject: Three adult women with original fictional identities stand together: left wears an ivory silk satin midi dress with dark-brown loose waves; center wears a deep wine-red sleek dress with copper-red waves; right wears a blush-pink modern mini dress with polished golden-blonde waves. All have calm, confident editorial expressions and natural refined makeup.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium-long three-quarter group portrait, left model relaxed and elegant, center facing front with subtle turn, right angled toward center, balanced spacing and coordinated neutral-to-wine palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cinematic soft light with smooth highlights and soft shadows, warm-gray textured studio backdrop, natural warm D65 color treatment, polished luxury atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical, 4K-style photorealistic fashion photography, realistic silk and fabric detail, sharp group focus, natural anatomy, no text or logos.
